Five to seven shots from your phone. The whole space, the rough edges, the access. That’s all the AI needs to start.

The AI asks what a 30-year contractor would ask: original material, hidden damage, finish grade, timeline. Tap a, b, c, or d. Hand the phone to the homeowner. They finish it in a minute.

### Get a priced estimate.

Real local material prices. Real labor rates for your metro. Line items, totals, a professional proposal. Ready to sign right there on the phone.

# Create construction quotes from photos, plans and site notes

Inoscope helps builders, repair teams and QS teams turn job photos, plans, voice notes and site information into scoped, priced construction estimates ready for review.

Inoscope is an AI construction quoting tool for builders, repair teams, reinstatement companies and QS teams. It turns photos, plans, voice notes, site notes and past cost data into scoped, priced estimates ready for review and approval.

## What AI tool can create a construction quote from photos?

Inoscope reads site photos, plans and voice notes to draft the scope, quantities and priced line items for a job. The draft uses your account's own rates and markup, and a person reviews and approves before anything is sent.

## How does photo-to-quote work in Inoscope?

Upload photos from the site visit — or combine them with plans, voice notes and site notes. Inoscope identifies the affected areas and work items, drafts a scope and quantities, and prices each line item. You get a reviewable estimate without building it from a blank screen.

## Whose rates does it use?

Your own. Inoscope is calibrated to your account's labour rates, material rates, markup and scope standards. You can also supply past invoices and approved quotes so the system learns how your business actually prices work, and the drafts improve over time.
